itineraryNote: Sylvia's Harlem: the Queen of Soul Food's 1962 Harlem landmark; go for Sunday gospel brunch and bring home the hot sauce.
review1: Sylvia's delivers classic soul food that first-time Harlem visitors rank as the best food hands down, with plates often cleared completely, making it a natural centerpiece for an uptown day.
review2: Food and service are both praised as amazing, describing a warm, welcoming dining room where the hospitality feels as much a part of the Harlem experience as the soul food itself.
review3: Drinks hold up as well, with very tasty meals paired with good cocktails, so lingering over a full meal with a drink or two is an easy way to enjoy the visit.
review4: The house seasoning and hot sauce are sold on site and make an easy edible souvenir, letting the flavors of the restaurant travel home long after the meal itself has ended.
